critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: /app/frontend/src/App.js was rendering `<ConfirmHost />` without importing it — this is exactly the kind of miss the agent-to-agent context note warned about ('main risk is ... the global ConfirmHost not rendering on some layout'). Compile passed because JSX identifiers are only checked at runtime. Suggest adding an eslint no-undef rule to CI to catch this class of bug pre-merge.

ConfirmHost keeps a module-scoped `_globalSetAsk` and reassigns it on every render — this works for a singleton but breaks if two <ConfirmHost/> instances ever get mounted (later mount wins, earlier orphans). Not currently an issue, but worth a `useLayoutEffect` guard + warn for future safety.

Deployment History delete dialog title is generic 'Please confirm' (from confirmAsync default) instead of a specific 'Delete release?' — inconsistent with the hand-converted Customers/Services/Reviews/Attendance titles. Consider passing `{ title: 'Delete release?', danger: true }` in DeploymentHistoryPanel.jsx line 24.

Same generic 'Please confirm' will apply to all 30+ mechanical `await confirmAsync(msg)` replacements — UX is functional but the dialog headers don't match the destructive intent (no red 'danger' styling either since default `danger: undefined`). Recommend passing `danger: true` for all delete/destructive calls in a follow-up polish pass.
action_items: Keep the added `import { ConfirmHost } from '@/components/ConfirmDialog'` in App.js — do NOT revert.
Optional polish: pass explicit `{ title, danger:true }` to confirmAsync in DeploymentHistoryPanel + other mechanically converted destructive flows so headers are descriptive/red.
Optional: add eslint 'no-undef' or a JSX-usage-vs-imports lint rule so future missed imports fail the build instead of crashing at runtime.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The ConfirmHost import is now in App.js line 39 — if it disappears, the whole app will crash. Deployments panel is NOT at the top level of super-admin tabs — you must first click the 'All' tab (the leftmost pill with the hamburger icon and count badge) which switches the view to reveal all sub-panels, then click the 'Deployments' button. When logging in as super after being logged in as salon admin (or vice versa), a hard navigation to /login inside the same context does NOT force logout — either open a fresh context or click Sign Out first. `release-delete-<id>` is the correct selector for deployment history delete buttons (not `delete-deployment-...`).
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/App.js line 199 rendered `<ConfirmHost />` but the top of the file (lines 1–70 of imports) never contained `import { ConfirmHost } from '@/components/ConfirmDialog'`. React runtime threw `ReferenceError: ConfirmHost is not defined` from the App component itself, so the AuthProvider tree never mounted post-login and every route rendered the CRA red error overlay. REPRO: open the app URL, log in as admin, observe the red overlay with 'ConfirmHost is not defined'. FIX APPLIED: single-line import added at line 39: `import { ConfirmHost } from "@/components/ConfirmDialog";`. After fix, all 8 destructive-action dialogs across Customers/Services/Reviews/Attendance/SuperAdmin(SMS/monthly/deployment history) render, open, and close correctly.
